blocks.text: Joy nomlari: the bilanmi, the sizmi?

Atoqli otlar — ismlar va ko'pchilik joy nomlari — odatda artiklsiz: Aziz, Tashkent, Uzbekistan. Nom o'zi yagona narsani ko'rsatadi, shuning uchun «qaysi biri?» degan savol yo'q. Lekin ko'p geografik nomlar **the** bilan aytiladi: **the** Amu Darya, **the** Aral Sea, **the** Fergana Valley, **the** USA. O'zbekchada bunga hech qanday ishora yo'q — «Amudaryo», «Orol dengizi», «AQSh» bir xil aytiladi. Bu yerda ham mantiq bor: nom ichida oddiy ot (republic, states, sea, valley) bo'lsa, nom ko'plikda bo'lsa yoki **of** bilan qurilgan bo'lsa — odatda **the**.
the siz: qit'alar, davlatlar, shaharlar, ko'llar

rows: Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, France, Japan, Turkey, South Korea
Lake Aydar (Aydarkul), Lake Baikal, Lake Victoria

blocks.text: Ko'llarga e'tibor bering: **Lake** so'zi nomdan oldin kelsa, **the** qo'yilmaydi — Lake Aydar, Lake Baikal. O'zbekcha «Aydarko'l» nomining o'zida «ko'l» bor, inglizchada ham u artiklsiz: Aydarkul. Daryolar esa, ko'rib turganimizdek, boshqacha — **the** bilan.

items.text: **Australia** is a continent and a country.

blocks.text: the bilan: Republic, Kingdom, States va ko'plikdagi nomlar

Davlat nomida **republic**, **kingdom**, **states**, **emirates** kabi oddiy ot bo'lsa — **the**: **the** United States (**the** USA), **the** United Kingdom (**the** UK), **the** Czech Republic, **the** United Arab Emirates (**the** UAE). Bu tushunarli: «qo'shma shtatlar», «birlashgan qirollik» — oddiy ot birikmasi, u aniq bitta davlatni bildiradi. Ko'plikdagi nomlar ham **the** oladi: **the** Netherlands, **the** Philippines, **the** Maldives. Qisqartma nomlarda ham **the** saqlanadi: in **the** USA («in USA» emas).
Suv: the Amu Darya, the Aral Sea, the Atlantic

Okean, dengiz, daryo va kanal nomlari doim **the** bilan: **the** Pacific (Ocean), **the** Atlantic, **the** Black Sea, **the** Caspian Sea, **the** Aral Sea, **the** Mediterranean, **the** Thames, **the** Nile, **the** Amu Darya, **the** Syr Darya, **the** Zarafshan, **the** Suez Canal. «River» so'zi ko'pincha tushib qoladi, lekin **the** qoladi: **the** Thames = **the** River Thames. «Darya» o'zbekcha «daryo» bo'lsa ham, inglizcha matnda **the** Amu Darya deyiladi.
Tog' tizmalari, orollar guruhi, cho'llar, vodiylar

Tog' tizmalari (ko'plikda) — **the**: **the** Alps, **the** Himalayas, **the** Andes, **the** Tian Shan, **the** Pamirs. Yakka tog' esa artiklsiz: Everest, Mount Kilimanjaro. Orollar guruhi — **the** Canaries, **the** Maldives; yakka orol — Bali, Cyprus. Cho'llar va vodiylar ham **the** bilan: **the** Sahara, **the** Kyzylkum (Desert), **the** Fergana Valley, **the** Zarafshan Valley.
Shahar ichida: ko'cha va park — the siz, muzey va mehmonxona — the bilan

Ko'cha, maydon, park, shuningdek joy nomi bilan atalgan aeroport va vokzallar — artiklsiz: Amir Temur Street, Oxford Street, Independence Square, Trafalgar Square, Hyde Park, Heathrow Airport, Victoria Station. Mehmonxona, muzey, teatr, kinoteatr va galereyalar esa — **the** bilan: **the** Hilton, **the** British Museum, **the** Navoi Theatre, **the** National Gallery. Egasining ismi bilan `'s` shaklida atalgan do'kon va restoranlar — artiklsiz: Harrods, McDonald's.
... of ... — doim the; the north of ...

Nomda **of** bo'lsa — deyarli doim **the**: **the** Great Wall **of** China, **the** Tower **of** London, **the** Bank **of** England, **the** Republic **of** Karakalpakstan, **the** University **of** Oxford (lekin: Oxford University — **of** siz, artiklsiz). Dunyo tomonlari ham shunday: **the** north **of** Uzbekistan, **the** south **of** England, **the** Middle East. Sifat shaklida esa artikl yo'q: **northern** Uzbekistan, **southern** Europe, South Korea.

items.text: Nukus is in **the north-west of Uzbekistan**.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «the Uzbekistan» → **Uzbekistan**; «I live in USA» → **I live in the USA**; «Amu Darya is long» → **The Amu Darya is long**; «the Lake Aydar» → **Lake Aydar**; «in Fergana Valley» → **in the Fergana Valley**; «on the Amir Temur Street» → **on Amir Temur Street**; «British Museum is free» → **The British Museum is free**; «in north of the country» → **in the north of the country**.

Eslab qolish: **suv** (okean, dengiz, daryo, kanal) — **the**, lekin **Lake** — the siz. **Ko'plik** (the Alps, the Netherlands) — **the**. Nomda **Republic / Kingdom / States** yoki **of** bo'lsa — **the**. Ko'cha, maydon, park — the siz; muzey, teatr, mehmonxona — **the**.

Istisnolar ham bor: **the** Hague (Gaaga shahri) — **the** bilan; Ukraine — hozir artiklsiz (eski matnlarda «the Ukraine»). Shubha bo'lsa, lug'at yoki xaritaga qarang: u yerda nom qanday yozilgan bo'lsa — shunday ishlating. Joylar bilan predloglar (in, at, on) — 106–108-darslar.

examples.title: No **the**: **Uzbekistan**, **Asia**, **Samarkand**
examples.description: Qit'alar, ko'pchilik davlatlar, shahar va yakka orollar — artiklsiz: **Asia**, **Uzbekistan**, **Japan**, **London**, **Bali**.

sentences.text: **Uzbekistan** is in **Central Asia**.
sentences.translation: **O'zbekiston** **Markaziy Osiyoda** joylashgan.

sentences.text: My cousin lives in **Canada**, not in **America**.
sentences.translation: Amakivachcham **Amerikada** emas, **Kanadada** yashaydi.

sentences.text: **Samarkand** is one of the oldest cities in **Asia**.
sentences.translation: **Samarqand** — **Osiyodagi** eng qadimiy shaharlardan biri.

sentences.text: Have you ever been to **Japan**? — No, but I'd love to go.
sentences.translation: Hech **Yaponiyada** bo'lganmisiz? — Yo'q, lekin borishni juda xohlardim.

sentences.text: Emma was born in **Scotland**, but she grew up in **London**.
sentences.translation: Emma **Shotlandiyada** tug'ilgan, lekin **Londonda** ulg'aygan.

sentences.text: Every year many tourists from **Europe** visit **Bukhara** and **Khiva**.
sentences.translation: Har yili **Yevropadan** ko'plab sayyohlar **Buxoro** va **Xivaga** keladi.

sentences.text: **Turkey** and **Egypt** are popular holiday destinations for Uzbek families.
sentences.translation: **Turkiya** va **Misr** — o'zbek oilalari uchun ommabop dam olish joylari.

sentences.text: We spent our honeymoon in **Bali**, a beautiful island in **Indonesia**.
sentences.translation: Asal oyimizni **Indoneziyadagi** go'zal orol — **Balida** o'tkazdik.

sentences.text: Is **Kazakhstan** bigger than **Uzbekistan**? — Yes, much bigger.
sentences.translation: **Qozog'iston** **O'zbekistondan** kattami? — Ha, ancha katta.

sentences.text: My brother works in **Moscow** and my sister studies in **Seoul**, so our family is spread across **Europe** and **Asia**.
sentences.translation: Akam **Moskvada** ishlaydi, singlim esa **Seulda** o'qiydi — oilamiz **Yevropa** va **Osiyo** bo'ylab tarqalib ketgan.

examples.title: **the USA**, **the UK**, **the Netherlands**
examples.description: Nomida Republic, Kingdom, States, Emirates bo'lgan va ko'plikdagi davlatlar — **the** bilan: **the** USA, **the** UK, **the** UAE, **the** Czech Republic, **the** Netherlands, **the** Philippines.

sentences.text: Sarah is from **the UK**, but her husband is from **Ireland**.
sentences.translation: Sara **Buyuk Britaniyadan**, eri esa **Irlandiyadan**.

sentences.text: Bekzod has been to **the USA** twice.
sentences.translation: Bekzod **AQShda** ikki marta bo'lgan.

sentences.text: **The Netherlands** is famous for its flowers and bicycles.
sentences.translation: **Niderlandiya** gullari va velosipedlari bilan mashhur.

sentences.text: Dubai is a big city in **the United Arab Emirates**.
sentences.translation: Dubay — **Birlashgan Arab Amirliklaridagi** katta shahar.

sentences.text: Prague is the capital of **the Czech Republic**.
sentences.translation: Praga — **Chexiya Respublikasining** poytaxti.

sentences.text: Have you ever been to **the Maldives**? — No, it's too expensive.
sentences.translation: **Maldiv orollarida** bo'lganmisiz? — Yo'q, u yer juda qimmat.

sentences.text: Last year James travelled around **the Philippines** for a month.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yili Jeyms bir oy **Filippin** bo'ylab sayohat qildi.

sentences.text: **The UK** is made up of England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland.
sentences.translation: **Buyuk Britaniya** Angliya, Shotlandiya, Uels va Shimoliy Irlandiyadan iborat.

sentences.text: Many Uzbek students study in **the USA**, but even more go to **South Korea**.
sentences.translation: Ko'p o'zbek talabalari **AQShda** o'qiydi, lekin **Janubiy Koreyaga** boradiganlar undan ham ko'p.

sentences.text: My uncle lived in **the United States** for ten years, but now he's back in **Uzbekistan**.
sentences.translation: Amakim o'n yil **Qo'shma Shtatlarda** yashadi, endi esa **O'zbekistonga** qaytdi.

examples.title: Water: **the Amu Darya**, **the Aral Sea** — but **Lake Aydar**
examples.description: Okean, dengiz, daryo, kanal — **the** bilan: **the** Amu Darya, **the** Thames, **the** Aral Sea, **the** Suez Canal. Ko'l esa **Lake** + nom, artiklsiz: **Lake Aydar**, **Lake Baikal**.

sentences.text: **The Amu Darya** is the longest river in Central Asia.
sentences.translation: **Amudaryo** — O'rta Osiyodagi eng uzun daryo.

sentences.text: London stands on **the Thames**.
sentences.translation: London **Temza** bo'yida joylashgan.

sentences.text: **The Aral Sea** is much smaller now than fifty years ago.
sentences.translation: **Orol dengizi** ellik yil oldingiga qaraganda ancha kichrayib qolgan.

sentences.text: We swam in **Lake Aydar** last summer.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yozda **Aydarko'lda** suzdik.

sentences.text: Is **the Caspian Sea** really a sea or a lake?
sentences.translation: **Kaspiy dengizi** haqiqatan dengizmi yoki ko'lmi?

sentences.text: **The Syr Darya** starts in the mountains of Kyrgyzstan.
sentences.translation: **Sirdaryo** Qirg'iziston tog'laridan boshlanadi.

sentences.text: Ships go from **the Mediterranean** to **the Red Sea** through **the Suez Canal**.
sentences.translation: Kemalar **O'rta yer dengizidan** **Qizil dengizga** **Suvaysh kanali** orqali o'tadi.

sentences.text: **Lake Baikal** in Russia is the deepest lake in the world.
sentences.translation: Rossiyadagi **Baykal ko'li** — dunyodagi eng chuqur ko'l.

sentences.text: Samarkand stands near **the Zarafshan**, and the river gives water to many villages.
sentences.translation: Samarqand **Zarafshon** bo'yida joylashgan, daryo ko'plab qishloqlarni suv bilan ta'minlaydi.

sentences.text: Our plane flew over **the Black Sea** and then over **the Atlantic** to New York.
sentences.translation: Samolyotimiz **Qora dengiz**, keyin **Atlantika okeani** ustidan Nyu-Yorkka uchdi.

examples.title: **the Tian Shan**, **the Fergana Valley** — but **Everest**
examples.description: Tog' tizmalari, cho'l va vodiylar — **the** bilan: **the** Tian Shan, **the** Pamirs, **the** Kyzylkum, **the** Fergana Valley. Yakka tog' — artiklsiz: **Everest**, **Kilimanjaro**.

sentences.text: More people live in **the Fergana Valley** than in any other part of Uzbekistan.
sentences.translation: **Farg'ona vodiysida** O'zbekistonning boshqa har qanday hududidan ko'ra ko'proq odam yashaydi.

sentences.text: **The Andes** run along the west coast of South America.
sentences.translation: **And tog'lari** Janubiy Amerikaning g'arbiy qirg'og'i bo'ylab cho'zilgan.

sentences.text: **Everest** is in **the Himalayas**, on the border of Nepal and China.
sentences.translation: **Everest** **Himolay tog'larida**, Nepal va Xitoy chegarasida joylashgan.

sentences.text: **The Kyzylkum Desert** is very hot in summer and cold in winter.
sentences.translation: **Qizilqum cho'li** yozda juda issiq, qishda sovuq bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Chimgan is a ski resort in the western part of **the Tian Shan**.
sentences.translation: Chimyon — **Tyan-Shan tog'larining** g'arbiy qismidagi chang'i kurorti.

sentences.text: Have you ever crossed **the Sahara**? — No, only the Kyzylkum!
sentences.translation: Hech **Sahroi Kabirni** kesib o'tganmisiz? — Yo'q, faqat Qizilqumni!

sentences.text: **The Pamirs** are often called the Roof of the World.
sentences.translation: **Pomir** ko'pincha «Dunyo tomi» deb ataladi.

sentences.text: In **the Zarafshan Valley** farmers grow apricots and grapes.
sentences.translation: **Zarafshon vodiysida** dehqonlar o'rik va uzum yetishtiradi.

sentences.text: Every winter Tom goes skiing in **the Alps**, but this year he's going to **the Rocky Mountains**.
sentences.translation: Tom har qishda **Alp tog'larida** chang'i uchadi, bu yil esa **Qoyali tog'larga** boryapti.

sentences.text: At fifty my uncle climbed **Kilimanjaro**, the highest mountain in **Africa**.
sentences.translation: Amakim ellik yoshida **Afrikadagi** eng baland tog' — **Kilimanjaroga** chiqdi.

examples.title: In town: **Amir Temur Street**, **Hyde Park**
examples.description: Ko'cha, maydon, park, aeroport va vokzal nomlari — artiklsiz: **Amir Temur Street**, **Independence Square**, **Hyde Park**, **Heathrow Airport**. `'s` li do'konlar ham: **Harrods**.

sentences.text: The hotel is on **Amir Temur Street**.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona **Amir Temur ko'chasida**.

sentences.text: Let's meet in **Independence Square** at five.
sentences.translation: Soat beshda **Mustaqillik maydonida** uchrashaylik.

sentences.text: **Oxford Street** is the busiest shopping street in London.
sentences.translation: **Oksford-strit** — Londondagi eng gavjum savdo ko'chasi.

sentences.text: We had a picnic in **Hyde Park** on Sunday.
sentences.translation: Yakshanba kuni **Gayd-parkda** piknik qildik.

sentences.text: Our flight lands at **Heathrow Airport** at six in the morning.
sentences.translation: Samolyotimiz ertalab soat oltida **Xitrou aeroportiga** qo'nadi.

sentences.text: Trains to Cambridge leave from **King's Cross Station**.
sentences.translation: Kembrijga poyezdlar **King's-Kross vokzalidan** jo'naydi.

sentences.text: Is **Navoi Street** far from here? — No, it's just round the corner.
sentences.translation: **Navoiy ko'chasi** bu yerdan uzoqmi? — Yo'q, shundoq muyulishda.

sentences.text: Thousands of tourists take photos in **Trafalgar Square** every day.
sentences.translation: Har kuni **Trafalgar maydonida** minglab sayyohlar suratga tushadi.

sentences.text: Aziz bought his suit at **Harrods**, so it was very expensive.
sentences.translation: Aziz kostyumini **Harrodsdan** olgan, shuning uchun u juda qimmat edi.

sentences.text: After lunch at **McDonald's** we walked along **Broadway** to **Central Park**.
sentences.translation: **McDonald'sda** tushlik qilgach, **Brodvey** bo'ylab **Markaziy parkka** piyoda bordik.

examples.title: **the Hilton**, **the British Museum**, **the Navoi Theatre**
examples.description: Mehmonxona, muzey, teatr, kinoteatr va galereya nomlari — **the** bilan: **the** Hilton, **the** Louvre, **the** Navoi Theatre, **the** National Gallery, **the** Odeon.

sentences.text: We stayed at **the Hilton** in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Toshkentda **Hilton** mehmonxonasida to'xtadik.

sentences.text: **The British Museum** is free for everyone.
sentences.translation: **Britaniya muzeyi** hamma uchun bepul.

sentences.text: Tonight we're going to an opera at **the Navoi Theatre**.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun **Navoiy teatriga** operaga boramiz.

sentences.text: Have you seen the new film at **the Odeon**?
sentences.translation: **Odeon** kinoteatridagi yangi filmni ko'rdingizmi?

sentences.text: **The Amir Timur Museum** has a beautiful blue dome.
sentences.translation: **Amir Temur muzeyining** chiroyli moviy gumbazi bor.

sentences.text: Sarah works as a guide at **the National Gallery** in London.
sentences.translation: Sara Londondagi **Milliy galereyada** gid bo'lib ishlaydi.

sentences.text: Is **the Hyatt Regency** near Amir Temur Square? — Yes, very close.
sentences.translation: **Hyatt Regency** Amir Temur maydoni yaqinidami? — Ha, juda yaqin.

sentences.text: **The Louvre** in Paris has more than thirty thousand works of art.
sentences.translation: Parijdagi **Luvrda** o'ttiz mingdan ortiq san'at asari bor.

sentences.text: Our class visited **the Museum of Applied Arts**, and then we had lunch in a café.
sentences.translation: Sinfimiz **Amaliy san'at muzeyiga** bordi, keyin kafeda tushlik qildik.

sentences.text: Bekzod booked a room at **the Grand Hotel**, but when he arrived, the hotel was full.
sentences.translation: Bekzod **Grand Hotel**dan xona band qilgan edi, lekin u yetib kelganda mehmonxonada joy qolmagan ekan.

examples.title: **the** ... **of** ...: the Tower of London, the north of
examples.description: Nomda **of** bo'lsa — **the**: **the** Great Wall **of** China, **the** University **of** Edinburgh. Dunyo tomonlari: **the** west **of** Uzbekistan, **the** Middle East; lekin **northern** Europe — artiklsiz.

sentences.text: **The Great Wall of China** is thousands of kilometres long.
sentences.translation: **Buyuk Xitoy devori** minglab kilometr uzunlikda.

sentences.text: Khiva is in **the west of Uzbekistan**.
sentences.translation: Xiva **O'zbekistonning g'arbida** joylashgan.

sentences.text: We visited **the Tower of London** on our first day.
sentences.translation: Birinchi kunimiz **London minorasini** ko'rgani bordik.

sentences.text: Termez is in **the south of the country**, near Afghanistan.
sentences.translation: Termiz **mamlakatning janubida**, Afg'oniston yaqinida.

sentences.text: Emma studied history at **the University of Edinburgh**.
sentences.translation: Emma **Edinburg universitetida** tarix bo'yicha o'qigan.

sentences.text: Tom's father works at **the Bank of England**.
sentences.translation: Tomning otasi **Angliya bankida** ishlaydi.

sentences.text: It rains a lot in **the north of England**, so take an umbrella.
sentences.translation: **Angliyaning shimolida** yomg'ir ko'p yog'adi, soyabon olib oling.

sentences.text: **The Statue of Liberty** was a gift from France to the USA.
sentences.translation: **Ozodlik haykali** Fransiyaning AQShga sovg'asi bo'lgan.

sentences.text: Nukus is the capital of **the Republic of Karakalpakstan**.
sentences.translation: Nukus — **Qoraqalpog'iston Respublikasining** poytaxti.

sentences.text: Bekzod has travelled a lot in **the Middle East**, but he has never been to **northern Europe**.
sentences.translation: Bekzod **Yaqin Sharqda** ko'p sayohat qilgan, lekin **Shimoliy Yevropada** hech qachon bo'lmagan.

examples.title: Dialogue: planning a trip to Uzbekistan
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: artiklsiz nomlar (Spain, Tashkent, Margilan, Lake Aydar, Heathrow) va **the** bilan (the Fergana Valley, the Aral Sea, the Amu Darya, the Kyzylkum Desert, the UAE).

sentences.text: — Sarah, are you going to **Spain** again this summer?
sentences.translation: — Sara, bu yoz yana **Ispaniyaga** borasanmi?

sentences.text: — No, this time I want to see **Uzbekistan** and **Central Asia**.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, bu safar **O'zbekiston** va **Markaziy Osiyoni** ko'rmoqchiman.

sentences.text: — Great choice! Start in **Tashkent**, then take the train to **Samarkand**.
sentences.translation: — Ajoyib tanlov! **Toshkentdan** boshla, keyin poyezdda **Samarqandga** bor.

sentences.text: — Is it true that **the Fergana Valley** is very green?
sentences.translation: — **Farg'ona vodiysi** juda yam-yashil ekani rostmi?

sentences.text: — Yes, and you can buy beautiful silk in **Margilan**.
sentences.translation: — Ha, **Marg'ilonda** chiroyli atlas sotib olishing mumkin.

sentences.text: — I also want to see **the Aral Sea**. Is it far?
sentences.translation: — **Orol dengizini** ham ko'rmoqchiman. Uzoqmi?

sentences.text: — Quite far. It's in **the north-west**, near the delta of **the Amu Darya**.
sentences.translation: — Ancha uzoq. U **shimoli-g'arbda**, **Amudaryo** deltasi yaqinida.

sentences.text: — And what about **Lake Aydar**? My friend says it's lovely.
sentences.translation: — **Aydarko'l**-chi? Do'stimning aytishicha, u yer juda go'zal.

sentences.text: — It is! You can stay in a yurt in **the Kyzylkum Desert** nearby.
sentences.translation: — Rost! Yaqin atrofdagi **Qizilqum cho'lida** o'tovda tunashing mumkin.

sentences.text: — Perfect! I'll fly from **Heathrow** and come back through **the UAE**.
sentences.translation: — Zo'r! **Xitroudan** uchib ketaman, **BAA** orqali qaytaman.
